official_search_result: Recursive listing of HenryZhu1029/EvoReal at the pinned commit contains no FFT/histogram/NN-ratio feature implementation. Author S1/S2/S3 TSPLIB validation coordinates exist as tsplib_typeS{1,2,3}.txt and were used for calibration.
energy_note: Paper says 'mean energy of the main frequency region (excluding the DC component)'. Official code is unpublished. Mean |FFT| of the lowest non-DC frequency annulus is the statistic whose numerical scale is comparable to the published threshold FFT=35 on the author's labeled validation instances. Total/Parseval spectral energy is rejected.
main_frequency_region_definition: fftshifted polar annulus 1 < r <= 4 pixels from DC
nn_std_note: No official NN-ratio code is published. numpy.std default ddof=0 is used because d_NN is the complete finite set of N nearest-neighbor distances of one instance, not a sample from a super-population. ddof=0 and ddof=1 both recover the author's S2<0.5 / S3>=0.5 split exactly on the 48 validation instances.

legacy_incorrect_implementation.fft: Parseval-style total spectral energy after independent-axis min-max; saturates near 16284
